name: anthropic-subscription
description: Build-only grouping for this plugin bundle's packages — declares no dependencies of its own. `pnpm run build` (from this directory, or `pnpm --filter anthropic-subscription run build` from the root) builds every package below in the same host-then-client order the root's own `build` script uses: the client packages import the Typert `/remote` stub that only exists once the host packages' own tsdown pass has generated it.

scripts.build:host: tsc -b api-authorization-controller cli-login-app && (cd ../.. && tsdown --filter dsh-plugins-api-authorization-controller --filter dsh-plugins-cli-login-app)
scripts.build:client: tsc -b client-remotes-anthropic-subscription client-ui-settings-anthropic-subscription && for d in client-remotes-anthropic-subscription client-ui-settings-anthropic-subscription; do (cd "$d" && tsdown) || exit 1; done
scripts.build: pnpm run build:host && pnpm run build:client
